intro: 本章把电路从“一点”扩展到“一条线”：线路尺寸可与波长相比时，电压、电流是位置 x 和时间 t 的函数。核心工具是传输线方程的解——入射波加反射波，由副参数 Z_c 和 γ 描述；负载决定反射系数，反射决定驻波和输入阻抗。始终先标清 x 从哪一端量起、电流沿哪个方向为正，并分清哪些公式只对无损耗线成立。

ideas.title: 分布参数电路：什么时候不能把导线当成“一点”
text: 集总参数电路假设电磁波“瞬间”传遍整个电路：同一根导线上各处的电流相同，两点之间的电压与路径无关。电路尺寸 l 和工作波长 λ = v_p/f 可比时，这个假设不再成立——沿线各处电压、电流的相位（甚至大小）都不同，必须把线路看成**分布参数电路**：每一小段 dx 都有串联的 R_0dx、L_0dx 和并联的 G_0dx、C_0dx。
判断依据是 **l/λ**，不是 l 本身：300 km 的 50 Hz 输电线只有 0.05λ，却已有 18° 的相位差；0.3 m 的电路板走线在 1 GHz 下有 1.5λ。工程上 l/λ 超过约 1/100～1/20 就要考虑分布参数。

en.title: Distributed-parameter circuits: when a wire is no longer a 'point'
text: Lumped circuits assume that electromagnetic waves cross the whole circuit instantly: the current is the same everywhere along a wire and the voltage between two points does not depend on the path. When the size l is comparable with the wavelength λ = v_p/f this fails — voltage and current have different phases (even magnitudes) at different points, and the line must be treated as a **distributed-parameter circuit**: every piece dx has series R_0dx, L_0dx and shunt G_0dx, C_0dx.

The test is **l/λ**, not l: a 300 km line at 50 Hz is only 0.05λ yet already shows an 18° phase shift; a 0.3 m PCB trace at 1 GHz is 1.5λ. In practice distributed effects matter once l/λ exceeds about 1/100–1/20.

ideas.title: 均匀传输线方程与原参数
text: **原参数** R_0、L_0、G_0、C_0 是单位长度的电阻、电感、电导、电容（Ω/m、H/m、S/m、F/m），沿线处处相同的线叫**均匀传输线**。取 x 从始端量起，v(x, t) 是两线之间的电压，i(x, t) 是沿 +x 方向的电流，对 dx 段列 KVL、KCL 就得到传输线方程（电报方程）。
正弦稳态下用相量：dV̇/dx = −Z_0İ，dİ/dx = −Y_{0}V̇，Z_0 = R_0 + jωL_0，Y_0 = G_0 + jωC_0。消去一个变量得到 d²V̇/dx² = γ²V̇，γ² = Z_0Y_0。

en.title: The uniform-line equations and the primary parameters
text: The **primary parameters** R_0, L_0, G_0, C_0 are the resistance, inductance, conductance and capacitance per unit length (Ω/m, H/m, S/m, F/m); a line with the same values everywhere is a **uniform line**. With x measured from the start, v(x, t) the voltage between the conductors and i(x, t) the current in the +x direction, KVL and KCL for a piece dx give the line (telegrapher's) equations.
In sinusoidal steady state with phasors: dV̇/dx = −Z_0İ, dİ/dx = −Y_{0}V̇ with Z_0 = R_0 + jωL_0, Y_0 = G_0 + jωC_0. Eliminating one variable gives d²V̇/dx² = γ²V̇ with γ² = Z_0Y_0.

ideas.title: 副参数：特性阻抗 Z_c 和传播常数 γ
text: **特性阻抗** Z_c = √(Z_0/Y_0)，**传播常数** γ = √(Z_0Y_0) = α + jβ（取实部为正的根）。α 是**衰减常数**（Np/m），β 是**相位常数**（rad/m）。它们只由原参数和频率决定，与负载、电源都无关。
由 β 得到**波长** λ = 2π/β 和**相速** v_p = ω/β。架空线 v_p 接近光速；电缆里 v_p 约为光速的 2/3。检查：Z_c·γ = Z_0，γ/Z_c = Y_0。

en.title: Secondary parameters: characteristic impedance Z_c and propagation constant γ
text: The **characteristic impedance** Z_c = √(Z_0/Y_0) and the **propagation constant** γ = √(Z_0Y_0) = α + jβ (the root with positive real part). α is the **attenuation constant** (Np/m), β the **phase constant** (rad/m). They depend only on the primary parameters and the frequency, not on the load or the source.
From β follow the **wavelength** λ = 2π/β and the **phase velocity** v_p = ω/β. On overhead lines v_p is close to the speed of light; in cables about 2/3 of it. Check: Z_c·γ = Z_0, γ/Z_c = Y_0.

ideas.title: 正弦稳态解：从终端写起的双曲函数形式
text: 已知终端（x′ = 0）的 V̇_2 和 İ_2（流进负载）时，用从终端量起的 x′ 写解最方便：V̇(x′) = V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′，İ(x′) = (V̇_2/Z_c) sinh γx′ + İ_2 cosh γx′。令 x′ = l 就得到始端值。
这正是一个互易二端口的 A 参数：A = D = cosh γl，B = Z_c sinh γl，C = sinh γl/Z_c，AD − BC = 1。所以传输线可以和其他元件一起放在普通的正弦稳态电路里计算。终端开路（İ_2 = 0）时始端电压比终端低：无损耗线 V_1 = V_2 cos βl——空载长线的末端电压升高。

en.title: Sinusoidal steady-state solution: the hyperbolic form written from the end
text: When the end values V̇_2 and İ_2 (into the load) are known, write the solution with x′ measured from the end: V̇(x′) = V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′, İ(x′) = (V̇_2/Z_c) sinh γx′ + İ_2 cosh γx′. Put x′ = l for the start values.

These are exactly the chain (A) parameters of a reciprocal two-port: A = D = cosh γl, B = Z_c sinh γl, C = sinh γl/Z_c, AD − BC = 1 — so a line can be analysed inside an ordinary sinusoidal steady-state circuit. With the end open (İ_2 = 0) the start voltage is lower than the end voltage: on a lossless line V_1 = V_2 cos βl — the voltage rise at the end of an unloaded long line.

ideas.title: 行波：入射波与反射波
text: 通解 V̇(x) = V̇⁺e^{−γx} + V̇⁻e^{γx}：第一项沿 +x 传播、越走越小、相位越来越滞后，是**入射波**（正向行波）；第二项沿 −x 传播，是**反射波**。电流 İ = (V̇⁺e^{−γx} − V̇⁻e^{γx})/Z_c：对每一个行波，电压/电流 = ±Z_c——反射波的电流带负号。
在时域，入射波是 √2V⁺e^{−αx}cos(ωt − βx + ψ)：等相位点以 v_p = ω/β 前进，相距 λ 的两点相位相同。

en.title: Travelling waves: incident and reflected
text: The general solution V̇(x) = V̇⁺e^{−γx} + V̇⁻e^{γx}: the first term travels in +x, shrinking and lagging more and more — the **incident** (forward) wave; the second travels in −x — the **reflected** wave. The current is İ = (V̇⁺e^{−γx} − V̇⁻e^{γx})/Z_c: for each wave voltage/current = ±Z_c — the reflected wave's current carries a minus sign.
In the time domain the incident wave is √2V⁺e^{−αx}cos(ωt − βx + ψ): points of equal phase move at v_p = ω/β, and points λ apart are in phase.

ideas.title: 反射系数与匹配
text: **反射系数** Γ = V̇⁻/V̇⁺（同一点的反射波与入射波电压之比）。终端 Γ_2 = (Z_2 − Z_c)/(Z_2 + Z_c)；向始端移动 x′，Γ(x′) = Γ_{2}e^{−2γx′}——无损耗线上只转相位，模不变。开路 Γ_2 = 1，短路 Γ_2 = −1，纯电抗负载 |Γ_2| = 1（全反射）。
Z_2 = Z_c 时 Γ_2 = 0，线上只有入射波，叫**匹配**（终端接特性阻抗）。这时任一点的输入阻抗都等于 Z_c，负载吸收入射波带来的全部功率，P_2 = P_{1}e^{−2αl}。不匹配时负载功率 ∝ (1 − |Γ_2|²)。

en.title: Reflection coefficient and matching
text: The **reflection coefficient** Γ = V̇⁻/V̇⁺ (reflected over incident voltage at the same point). At the end Γ_2 = (Z_2 − Z_c)/(Z_2 + Z_c); moving x′ towards the start, Γ(x′) = Γ_{2}e^{−2γx′} — on a lossless line only its angle turns. Open end Γ_2 = 1, short Γ_2 = −1, a purely reactive load |Γ_2| = 1 (total reflection).

For Z_2 = Z_c, Γ_2 = 0 and only the incident wave exists: the line is **matched** (terminated in its characteristic impedance). Then the input impedance is Z_c at every point and the load absorbs all the incident power, P_2 = P_{1}e^{−2αl}. With a mismatch the load power is ∝ (1 − |Γ_2|²).

ideas.title: 无损耗线：输入阻抗、开路线与短路线
text: R_0 = G_0 = 0 时 Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) 是纯电阻，γ = jβ，β = ω√(L_0C_0)，v_p = 1/√(L_0C_0)，双曲函数变成三角函数：cosh jβx = cos βx，sinh jβx = j sin βx。输入阻抗 Z_in = Z_c(Z_2 + jZ_c tan βl)/(Z_c + jZ_2 tan βl)。
**终端开路**：Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl；**终端短路**：Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl——都是纯电抗，随长度在容性、感性之间交替，每 λ/4 换一次，所以短截线可以代替电感或电容。由两次测量可得 Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc)。
**λ/2 线**：Z_in = Z_2（阻抗每 λ/2 重复）；**λ/4 线**：Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2（阻抗倒置），短路的 λ/4 线相当于开路。

en.title: Lossless lines: input impedance, open and shorted lines
text: With R_0 = G_0 = 0, Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) is a pure resistance, γ = jβ with β = ω√(L_0C_0), v_p = 1/√(L_0C_0), and the hyperbolic functions become trigonometric: cosh jβx = cos βx, sinh jβx = j sin βx. Input impedance: Z_in = Z_c(Z_2 + jZ_c tan βl)/(Z_c + jZ_2 tan βl).

**Open end**: Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl; **shorted end**: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl — both pure reactances that alternate between capacitive and inductive every λ/4, which is why stubs can replace inductors and capacitors. Two measurements give Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc).
**λ/2 line**: Z_in = Z_2 (the impedance repeats every λ/2); **λ/4 line**: Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2 (impedance inversion) — a shorted λ/4 line looks like an open circuit.

ideas.title: 驻波与驻波比
text: 无损耗线上入射波和反射波叠加：|V̇(x′)| = V⁺|1 + Γ_{2}e^{−j2βx′}|，在 V⁺(1 + |Γ|) 和 V⁺(1 − |Γ|) 之间变化。电压最大处（波腹）Γ(x′) 为正实数，最小处（波节）为负实数，相邻波腹与波节相距 λ/4；电流的波腹在电压的波节处。
**驻波比** VSWR = V_max/V_min = (1 + |Γ|)/(1 − |Γ|)，从 1（行波）到 ∞（纯驻波：开路、短路、纯电抗负载）。纯驻波中波节处电压恒为零，能量只在电场和磁场之间来回交换，不向负载传送。Z_2 为电阻时：R_2 > Z_c 终端是电压波腹，R_2 < Z_c 终端是波节。

en.title: Standing waves and the standing-wave ratio
text: On a lossless line the incident and reflected waves add: |V̇(x′)| = V⁺|1 + Γ_{2}e^{−j2βx′}|, varying between V⁺(1 + |Γ|) and V⁺(1 − |Γ|). At a voltage maximum Γ(x′) is a positive real number, at a minimum a negative one; a maximum and the next minimum are λ/4 apart, and the current maxima sit at the voltage minima.

The **standing-wave ratio** VSWR = V_max/V_min = (1 + |Γ|)/(1 − |Γ|) runs from 1 (a pure travelling wave) to ∞ (a pure standing wave: open, short or reactive load). In a pure standing wave the voltage minima are permanently zero and energy only swings between electric and magnetic fields, none reaching the load. For a resistive load: R_2 > Z_c puts a voltage maximum at the end, R_2 < Z_c a minimum.

ideas.title: 匹配的方法：λ/4 变换器与短截线
text: **λ/4 阻抗变换器**：在 Z_c 的主线和电阻负载 R_L 之间串一段 λ/4 线，特性阻抗 Z_c1 = √(Z_cR_L)，输入阻抗就变成 Z_c。它只在设计频率附近有效（频率变化时 βl 不再是 90°）。
**单支节（短截线）匹配**：在离负载 d 处并联一段终端短路线。先选 d 使 Y_d = 1/Z_d 的实部等于 1/Z_c，再选短截线长度使它的输入导纳 −j cot(βl_s)/Z_c 抵消 Y_d 的虚部。并联用导纳相加。

en.title: Matching: the quarter-wave transformer and the stub
text: **Quarter-wave transformer**: between a main line Z_c and a resistive load R_L insert a λ/4 section with Z_c1 = √(Z_cR_L); the input impedance becomes Z_c. It works only near the design frequency (elsewhere βl is no longer 90°).

**Single-stub matching**: connect a shorted line in parallel at distance d from the load. Choose d so that Y_d = 1/Z_d has real part 1/Z_c, then the stub length so that its input admittance −j cot(βl_s)/Z_c cancels the imaginary part of Y_d. Parallel elements: add admittances.

ideas.title: 无畸变线
text: 信号含有许多频率。一般的线上 α 和 v_p 都随频率变化，各频率分量衰减不同、到达时间不同，波形就畸变了。当 **R_0/L_0 = G_0/C_0** 时：Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) 为纯电阻，α = √(R_0G_0) 与频率无关，β = ω√(L_0C_0) 与 ω 成正比，v_p = 1/√(L_0C_0) 也与频率无关——这就是**无畸变线**。
实际电缆一般 R_0/L_0 ≫ G_0/C_0，所以早期电话线要串入加感线圈增大 L_0，使它接近无畸变条件。

en.title: The distortionless line
text: A signal contains many frequencies. On a general line α and v_p both depend on frequency, so the components are attenuated differently and arrive at different times: the waveform is distorted. When **R_0/L_0 = G_0/C_0**: Z_c = √(L_0/C_0) is a pure resistance, α = √(R_0G_0) is independent of frequency, β = ω√(L_0C_0) is proportional to ω and v_p = 1/√(L_0C_0) is constant — the **distortionless line**.
Real cables usually have R_0/L_0 ≫ G_0/C_0, which is why telephone lines once had loading coils inserted to raise L_0 towards the distortionless condition.

ideas.title: 无损耗线的波过程（暂态）
text: 电源接通后，电压、电流以有限速度 v_p 沿线推进。波还没到达终端时，电源“看到”的只是一个电阻 Z_c：第一个波 v⁺ = V_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c)，i⁺ = v⁺/Z_c。
波到达一端时按该端的 Γ = (R − Z_c)/(R + Z_c) 反射（电阻端接），反射波往回走，到另一端再反射……某点某时刻的电压 = 已经到达该点的所有波之和；电流 = Σ(正向波 − 反向波)/Z_c。用时间–距离的**反射网格图**（单程 T = l/v_p）记账最清楚。
每走一个来回幅度乘 Γ_1Γ_2，|Γ_1Γ_2| < 1 时趋于直流稳态（无损耗线在直流下就是两根导线）；有一端匹配时，波到达那一端就不再反射。

en.title: Waves on a lossless line (transients)
text: After switching on, voltage and current advance along the line at the finite speed v_p. Until the wave reaches the end the source sees just a resistor Z_c: the first wave is v⁺ = V_s·Z_c/(R_s + Z_c), i⁺ = v⁺/Z_c.

At each end a wave is reflected with that end's Γ = (R − Z_c)/(R + Z_c) (resistive terminations), travels back, is reflected again… The voltage at a point and time is the sum of all waves that have arrived there; the current is Σ(forward − backward)/Z_c. A time–distance **lattice (bounce) diagram** (one-way time T = l/v_p) keeps the books.

Each round trip multiplies the amplitude by Γ_1Γ_2; for |Γ_1Γ_2| < 1 the line settles to the DC steady state (at DC a lossless line is two wires). If one end is matched, a wave reaching it is not reflected any more.

formulas.name: 均匀传输线方程
formulas.when: x 从始端量起指向终端；v 为两导线间的电压，i 为沿 +x 方向的电流；R_0、L_0、G_0、C_0 为单位长度参数。

en.name: Uniform-line (telegrapher's) equations
en.when: x from the start towards the end; v is the voltage between the conductors, i the current in +x; R_0, L_0, G_0, C_0 per unit length.

formulas.name: 相量形式
formulas.expr: dV̇/dx = −Z_0İ，　dİ/dx = −Y_{0}V̇，　Z_0 = R_0 + jωL_0，Y_0 = G_0 + jωC_0
formulas.when: 正弦稳态；方向约定同上。

en.name: Phasor form
en.expr: dV̇/dx = −Z_0İ，　dİ/dx = −Y_{0}V̇，　Z_0 = R_0 + jωL_0，Y_0 = G_0 + jωC_0
en.when: Sinusoidal steady state; same directions as above.

formulas.name: 特性阻抗、传播常数
formulas.when: 任意均匀线；γ 取实部 ≥ 0 的根。α：Np/m，β：rad/m。Z_c·γ = Z_0。

en.name: Characteristic impedance, propagation constant
en.when: Any uniform line; take the root of γ with real part ≥ 0. α in Np/m, β in rad/m. Z_c·γ = Z_0.

formulas.name: 波长、相速
formulas.when: β 为相位常数；有损耗线的 v_p 一般随频率变化。

en.name: Wavelength, phase velocity
en.when: β is the phase constant; on a lossy line v_p generally depends on frequency.

formulas.name: 通解（行波形式）
formulas.when: x 从始端量起；第一项为入射波（沿 +x），第二项为反射波（沿 −x），反射波电流带负号。

en.name: General solution (travelling waves)
en.when: x from the start; the first term is the incident wave (+x), the second the reflected wave (−x), whose current carries a minus sign.

formulas.name: 已知终端值的解（双曲函数形式）
formulas.expr: V̇(x′) = V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′，　İ(x′) = (V̇_2/Z_c) sinh γx′ + İ_2 cosh γx′
formulas.when: x′ = l − x 从终端量起；V̇_2、İ_2 为终端电压和流进负载的电流。令 x′ = l 得始端值。

en.name: Solution from the end values (hyperbolic form)
en.expr: V̇(x′) = V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′，　İ(x′) = (V̇_2/Z_c) sinh γx′ + İ_2 cosh γx′
en.when: x′ = l − x from the end; V̇_2, İ_2 are the end voltage and the current into the load. x′ = l gives the start values.

formulas.name: 二端口（A 参数）
formulas.expr: A = D = cosh γl，　B = Z_c sinh γl，　C = sinh γl/Z_c，　AD − BC = 1
formulas.when: V̇_1 = AV̇_2 + Bİ_2，İ_1 = CV̇_2 + Dİ_2；İ_2 流出端口 2（流进负载）。

en.name: Two-port (chain) parameters
en.expr: A = D = cosh γl，　B = Z_c sinh γl，　C = sinh γl/Z_c，　AD − BC = 1
en.when: V̇_1 = AV̇_2 + Bİ_2, İ_1 = CV̇_2 + Dİ_2 with İ_2 leaving port 2 (into the load).

formulas.name: 反射系数
formulas.when: Γ = V̇⁻/V̇⁺（电压反射系数）；x′ 从终端量起。开路 +1，短路 −1，匹配 0。

en.name: Reflection coefficient
en.when: Γ = V̇⁻/V̇⁺ (voltage reflection coefficient); x′ from the end. Open +1, short −1, matched 0.

formulas.name: 输入阻抗（一般线）
formulas.expr: Z_in = Z_c\frac{Z_2 + Z_c tanh γl}{Z_c + Z_2 tanh γl}
formulas.when: 从始端向终端（连同负载 Z_2）看进去；任意均匀线。匹配（Z_2 = Z_c）时 Z_in = Z_c。

en.name: Input impedance (general line)
en.expr: Z_in = Z_c\frac{Z_2 + Z_c tanh γl}{Z_c + Z_2 tanh γl}
en.when: Seen at the start looking towards the end (load Z_2 included); any uniform line. Matched (Z_2 = Z_c): Z_in = Z_c.

formulas.name: 无损耗线的副参数
formulas.when: 只适用于 R_0 = G_0 = 0（低损耗时近似）；α = 0，Z_c 为纯电阻。

en.name: Secondary parameters of a lossless line
en.when: Only for R_0 = G_0 = 0 (approximately for low loss); α = 0 and Z_c is purely resistive.

formulas.name: 无损耗线的输入阻抗
formulas.expr: Z_in = Z_c\frac{Z_2 + jZ_c tan βl}{Z_c + jZ_2 tan βl}
formulas.when: 只适用于无损耗线；有损耗线用 tanh γl 的形式。

en.name: Input impedance of a lossless line
en.expr: Z_in = Z_c\frac{Z_2 + jZ_c tan βl}{Z_c + jZ_2 tan βl}
en.when: Lossless lines only; for a lossy line use the tanh γl form.

formulas.name: 开路线、短路线
formulas.expr: Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl，　Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl，　Z_c = \sqrt{Z_ocZ_sc}
formulas.when: 无损耗线；l < λ/4 时开路线呈容性、短路线呈感性，每增加 λ/4 互换。Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc) 对有损耗线也成立。

en.name: Open and shorted lines
en.expr: Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl，　Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl，　Z_c = \sqrt{Z_ocZ_sc}
en.when: Lossless line; for l < λ/4 the open line is capacitive and the shorted one inductive, swapping every λ/4. Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc) also holds for lossy lines.

formulas.name: λ/4 线与 λ/2 线
formulas.expr: l = λ/4：Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2；　l = λ/2：Z_in = Z_2
formulas.when: 无损耗线，只在使 βl = 90° 或 180° 的频率上成立。

en.name: Quarter- and half-wave lines
en.expr: l = λ/4: Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2;　l = λ/2: Z_in = Z_2
en.when: Lossless line, only at the frequency where βl = 90° or 180°.

formulas.name: 驻波比、电压极值
formulas.when: 无损耗线（|Γ| 沿线不变）；V⁺ 为入射波有效值。相邻波腹与波节相距 λ/4，波腹处 Γ(x′) 为正实数。

en.name: VSWR and voltage extremes
en.when: Lossless line (|Γ| constant along it); V⁺ is the rms incident wave. A maximum and the next minimum are λ/4 apart; at a maximum Γ(x′) is real and positive.

formulas.name: λ/4 阻抗变换器
formulas.when: 负载 R_L 为纯电阻；匹配段长 λ/4（设计频率）。

en.name: Quarter-wave transformer
en.when: Resistive load R_L; section length λ/4 at the design frequency.

formulas.name: 短路短截线的输入导纳
formulas.when: 无损耗、终端短路；与主线在同一点并联，导纳相加。

en.name: Input admittance of a shorted stub
en.when: Lossless, shorted end; it is connected in parallel with the main line, so admittances add.

formulas.name: 无畸变条件
formulas.when: 所有频率的 α、v_p 相同，Z_c 为纯电阻。

en.name: Distortionless condition
en.when: α and v_p are the same at every frequency and Z_c is purely resistive.

formulas.name: 沿线功率、效率
formulas.expr: P(x) = Re[V̇(x)İ*(x)]，　匹配时 P_2 = P_{1}e^{−2αl}
formulas.when: 有效值相量；İ 沿 +x 方向。匹配公式只在 Z_2 = Z_c 时成立。

en.name: Power along the line, efficiency
en.when: rms phasors; İ in the +x direction. The matched formula needs Z_2 = Z_c.

formulas.name: 波过程（电阻端接的无损耗线）
formulas.expr: v⁺ = \frac{V_sZ_c}{R_s + Z_c}，　Γ = \frac{R − Z_c}{R + Z_c}，　T = l/v_p
formulas.when: 无损耗线，原来不带电，阶跃电源只在始端；正向波电流 = v/Z_c，反向波电流 = −v/Z_c。

en.name: Waves on a resistively terminated lossless line
en.expr: v⁺ = \frac{V_sZ_c}{R_s + Z_c}，　Γ = \frac{R − Z_c}{R + Z_c}，　T = l/v_p
en.when: Lossless, initially uncharged line, step source at the start only; a forward wave carries current v/Z_c, a backward wave −v/Z_c.

examples.title: 不匹配的无损耗线：输入阻抗、反射和驻波
examples.statement: 75 Ω 无损耗线长 0.75 m，v_p = 3×10⁸ m/s，f = 150 MHz；信号源 V̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），R_s = 75 Ω；负载 R_L = 150 Ω。求输入阻抗、Γ_2、驻波比、电压的最大最小值和负载功率。x′ 从终端量起。
steps: 4. **入射波。** R_s = Z_c，始端不再反射：V⁺ = V_s/2 = **5 V**。

en.title: A mismatched lossless line: input impedance, reflection and standing waves
en.statement: A 75 Ω lossless line 0.75 m long, v_p = 3×10⁸ m/s, f = 150 MHz; source V̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), R_s = 75 Ω; load R_L = 150 Ω. Find the input impedance, Γ_2, the VSWR, the largest and smallest voltage and the load power. x′ is measured from the end.
steps: 1. **Electrical length.** λ = v_p/f = **2 m**, l = 0.75 m = 3λ/8, βl = 135°, tan βl = −1.
2. **Input impedance.** Z_in = 75 × (150 − j75)/(75 − j150) = **(60 + j45) Ω**: the line turns a resistive load into an inductive impedance.
4. **Incident wave.** R_s = Z_c, nothing is re-reflected at the start: V⁺ = V_s/2 = **5 V**.
5. **Standing wave.** R_L > Z_c puts a voltage maximum at the end: V_max = 5 × 4/3 = **6.67 V**; λ/4 = **0.5 m** from the end is a minimum, V_min = 5 × 2/3 = **3.33 V**.

examples.title: 开路线的波过程：电压一步步爬到 10 V
examples.statement: 无损耗线 Z_c = 50 Ω，长 600 m，v_p = 3×10⁸ m/s，终端开路，原来不带电。t = 0 时接通 V_s = 10 V（阶跃），R_s = 150 Ω。用反射网格图求始端和终端电压随时间的变化。

en.title: Waves on an open line: the voltage climbs to 10 V step by step
en.statement: A lossless line, Z_c = 50 Ω, 600 m long, v_p = 3×10⁸ m/s, open at the end, initially uncharged. At t = 0 a step V_s = 10 V with R_s = 150 Ω is connected. Use a bounce diagram to follow the start and end voltages in time.
steps: 2. **First wave.** The line looks like Z_c to the source: v⁺ = 10 × 50/(150 + 50) = **2.5 V**.

4. **Lattice.** T: the 2.5 V wave reaches the end and is totally reflected, v_2 = **5 V**; 2T: it returns to the start and 0.5 × 2.5 = 1.25 is reflected, v_1 = 2.5 + 2.5 + 1.25 = **6.25 V**; 3T: that wave doubles at the end, v_2 = 5 + 2.5 = **7.5 V**; and so on.
5. **Final value.** Each round trip multiplies by Γ_1Γ_2 = 0.5: v_2(∞) = 2 × 2.5/(1 − 0.5) = **10 V** = V_s (no current in R_s with the end open) ✓.

mistakes.text: 把 x 和 x′ 混用：从始端量起的解里是 e^{−γx}（入射波），从终端量起的解里 V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′ 全是正号。先在图上标出 x 的起点和 İ 的参考方向（沿 +x），再选公式。

en.text: Mixing up x and x′: measured from the start the incident wave is e^{−γx}; measured from the end the solution V̇_2 cosh γx′ + Z_cİ_2 sinh γx′ has only plus signs. Mark where x starts and the reference direction of İ (+x) before choosing a formula.

mistakes.text: 把无损耗线的公式（Z_c = √(L_0/C_0)、tan βl、λ/4 线 Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2）用在有损耗线上。有损耗时 Z_c 是复数，要用 tanh γl；输电线这类低损耗线用无损耗公式只是近似。

en.text: Using lossless formulas (Z_c = √(L_0/C_0), tan βl, the λ/4 rule Z_in = Z_c²/Z_2) on a lossy line. With losses Z_c is complex and tanh γl is needed; for low-loss power lines the lossless formulas are only an approximation.

mistakes.text: 认为反射波电流 = V̇⁻/Z_c。反射波沿 −x 传播，按 +x 的参考方向它的电流是 −V̇⁻/Z_c：开路端电压加倍、电流为零；短路端电压为零、电流加倍。

en.text: Taking the reflected current as V̇⁻/Z_c. The reflected wave travels in −x, so with the +x reference its current is −V̇⁻/Z_c: at an open end the voltage doubles and the current vanishes; at a short the voltage vanishes and the current doubles.

mistakes.text: 把开路和短路的反射系数记反：Γ_2 = (Z_2 − Z_c)/(Z_2 + Z_c)，开路 Z_2 → ∞ 得 +1，短路 Z_2 = 0 得 −1。

en.text: Swapping the reflection coefficients of open and short: Γ_2 = (Z_2 − Z_c)/(Z_2 + Z_c) gives +1 for Z_2 → ∞ (open) and −1 for Z_2 = 0 (short).

mistakes.text: 波过程中一接通就用负载电阻算电流。波到达终端之前（以及反射波回来之前），电源只“看到” Z_c：第一个波 v⁺ = V_sZ_c/(R_s + Z_c)，与 R_L 无关。

en.text: In a transient, using the load resistance right after switching on. Before the wave reaches the end (and before the reflection returns) the source sees only Z_c: the first wave v⁺ = V_sZ_c/(R_s + Z_c) does not depend on R_L.

mistakes.text: 认为 λ/4 变换器对任何频率、任何负载都匹配。它要求负载是纯电阻，并且只在 βl = 90° 的设计频率附近有效。

en.text: Expecting a quarter-wave transformer to match at every frequency and for every load. It needs a resistive load and works only near the design frequency where βl = 90°.

mistakes.text: 以为终端总是电压波腹（或波节）。只有电阻负载才在终端出现极值：R_2 > Z_c 是波腹，R_2 < Z_c 是波节；一般负载要由 Γ_2 的辐角算位置。

en.text: Assuming the end is always a voltage maximum (or minimum). Only a resistive load puts an extreme at the end — a maximum for R_2 > Z_c, a minimum for R_2 < Z_c; for a general load the angle of Γ_2 sets the positions.

en.intro: This chapter stretches a circuit from a 'point' to a 'line': when the line is comparable with the wavelength, voltage and current are functions of position x and time t. The key tool is the solution of the line equations — an incident plus a reflected wave described by the secondary parameters Z_c and γ; the load sets the reflection coefficient, and reflection sets the standing waves and the input impedance. Always mark where x is measured from and which way the current is positive, and keep track of which formulas hold only for lossless lines.
